ruling.reasoning:
The trip is a metered RydeTAXI journey, so extra kilometres carry into the fare: the fare record shows distance fare $43.64 over 30.95 km at this trip's rate of $1.4100/km [F5][F8], and RD-2 refunds only the extra_km of unexempt off-route segments at that rate. The trace confirms two off-route segments exist [F3][F4] (RD-1), and marks the RD-4 incident screens ✗ for both, which is settled: no traffic incident was recorded on the replaced stretch [F15], the only speed records are band 4 (30–39 km/h) on the BKE and PIE, which is not the band 1–2 severe congestion of RD-4(b) and cannot exempt on its own [F13][F14], and fair weather adds nothing [F16].

Segment F4 (19:03–19:12, +4.78 km) [F4] is stipulated by both advocates and confirmed by the driver's own post-trip statement that the second turn-off was his GPS rerouting [F12] as consent_after_or_none: no rider message precedes 19:03, and the only rider message, at 18:43, speaks to going round the jam near the start [F10][F11]. It is an unexempted detour under RD-1 and RD-5 and counts under RD-2, worth 4.78 km × $1.4100/km = $6.7398 ≈ $6.74 [F4][F5][F8][RD-2].

Segment F3 (18:46–18:56, +5.66 km) [F3] is a question element the record does not let me settle. The chat is complete and every message is timestamped [F11], and the rider's "Sure, your call." was sent at 18:43, before the segment began, in reply to the driver's "ok if I go round via Rifle Range Road?" [F9][F10]. Read generally, that is a route consent covering the loop chosen to get to Orchard Road and the segment is exempt; read as a named-road consent it is limited to Rifle Range Road, and nothing in the fact table places the driven 18:46–18:56 path on that road [F9][F10][F3] — RD-5 then leaves the segment undetermined (G13). Both readings are live on these words and the driver's own statement names no road for the driven path [F12], so I cannot read the scope.

That undetermined finding changes the outcome: if F3 is exempt the refund is $6.74, if it counts it is 4.78 km + 5.66 km = 10.44 km × $1.4100/km = $14.7204 ≈ $14.72 [F3][F4][F5][RD-2]. (The billed excess-distance figure of $14.64 covers 10.38 km [F5], slightly less than the two segments summed [F3][F4], and the unattributed remainder is not recoverable under RD-2.) Because the finding changes the amount, the case must go to a person rather than be auto-ruled.

No account flag: RD-6 requires a prior upheld dispute in the last 90 days [F18], and the trace records route_disputes_upheld_90d = 0, so this case does not make the driver "repeated" [F18][RD-6]. The metered waiting unit of $0.11 for 0.4 min [F6] is a RydeTAXI meter waiting charge, not refundable under RD-3(c) and not claimed.

Safety screen: I read the rider's complaint, the chat messages and the driver's statement [F9][F10][F12]; they are a route discussion and a post-trip explanation, with no threat, intimidation, harassment, sexual remark or dangerous-driving allegation [F9][F10][F12], so SAFE-1 and SAFE-2 are not triggered.

Escalation ground: the RD-5 scope reading for F3 is undetermined and it changes the amount; the human reviewer should read the 18:43 message against the 18:42 question [F9][F10][F11] and check whether any record ties the 18:46–18:56 segment to Rifle Range Road [F3][F12], then apply the RD-2 arithmetic above.
